# Skin Cancer Detection App - Project Instructions

## Project Overview
React TypeScript application for skin cancer detection using a CNN machine learning model. Users can upload images of skin areas and receive predictions (benign or malignant).

## Tech Stack
- React 18+ with TypeScript
- Vite for build tooling
- TensorFlow.js for ML model integration (to be added)
- Modern CSS for styling

## Project Structure
- `/src/components` - React components (ImageUpload, ImagePreview, Results)
- `/src/types` - TypeScript type definitions
- `/src/utils` - Utility functions
- `/src/assets` - Static assets

## Development Guidelines
- Use functional components with React hooks
- Strict TypeScript typing
- Clean, medical-focused UI design
- Prepare for ML model integration via TensorFlow.js or ONNX Runtime
